title: My philosophy regarding upper back training (part. 2)
summary: Second part of his upper back philosophy. He argues the upper back is the most neglected and underdeveloped muscle group in natural lifters relative to its size potential, and lays out his methods for building a big yoke. The captions are a garbled machine translation, so only the description's thesis survives.
claims: The upper back is the most neglected and underdeveloped muscle group in natural lifters compared to its huge potential for size
He applies specific methods to push the limits of upper back size and build a gigantic yoke
